Package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery

Class BeanQuery.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery.BeanQuery.Builder
Enclosing class:
BeanQuery
public static final class BeanQuery.Builder extends Object
Builds an immutable BeanQuery. Create with BeanQuery.create(); derive one from an existing query with BeanQuery.copy().

Exposes every BeanQuery.GroupBuilder condition method (they add top-level conditions here) plus view/sort/paging/opts/counts and build().

Example:

BeanQuery q = BeanQuery.create().eq("status", "active").build();

Since:
10.0.0
